shorthandPropertyAccessDestructuring.ts(5,4): error TS1560: A shorthand property expression cannot be used in a destructuring assignment target.


==== shorthandPropertyAccessDestructuring.ts (1 errors) ====
    declare const a: { b: { c: string } };
    
    // Not allowed as a destructuring target
    let target = { c: "" };
    ({ target.c } = a.b);
       ~~~~~~~~
!!! error TS1560: A shorthand property expression cannot be used in a destructuring assignment target.
